 'Hope for a big total' published at 08:40 BST 08:40 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images Pakistan captain Shaheen Afridi: "The last game we also batted first so it will not be too different. The boys are playing their second game and we got 200 in a [recent] T20 game so we will see how we go and hope for a big total.
 "Our players have experience - they have played enough - and they just need to bowl in the right areas, and in partnerships, and the wickets will come. 
 "I thought we played 50% or 60% in our batting in the first match. There were a few players not in their touch."

 England win toss and bowl published at 08:34 BST 08:34 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images Pakistan captain Shaheen Afridi has just given the coin a toss.
 Harry Brook called heads. It comes down a head and the England skipper decides he fancies a chase.
 England will bowl first.
 62 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Three's the magic number... published at 08:32 BST 08:32 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images In case you are unaware England are playing today as part of a tri-series in Pakistan, with Sri Lanka the other team taking part. 
 The three teams will play a double round-robin group stage, with each team facing the other two twice - six group games in total, meaning England play four group matches. 
 The top two teams qualify for what should be a, ahem, spooktacular final on 31 October, in Lahore.
Pakistan beat Sri Lanka by 37 runs in the first match of the series on Sunday.
 21 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Welcome... published at 08:29 BST 08:29 BST 
 The nights are drawing in, there's a chill in the air and the leaves are falling off the trees. 
 Kit bags have been put in lofts, averages have been tallied up and end-of-season awards dished out. 
 The summer may be over but take solace from the fact England's cricketers are never too far away from their next match. No winter off for them. 
 Welcome to live coverage of England's one-day international against Pakistan from the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium.
